description: Email systems do not implement spam filtering and protection mechanisms. This signal indicates that phishing, malware, and unwanted messages may reach users without filtering.
applicability: Applicable to all email systems. Includes spam filtering, email security gateways, phishing detection, and malicious attachment scanning.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through email security configuration review, spam filter deployment verification, and email gateway assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Information Integrity
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
